title: Data Academy
description: Learn to analyse small-scale fisheries data with interactive R lessons that run in your browser.

intro.title: Interactive R, right in your browser
intro.body: Each lesson runs real R code against your own landings data — the same data and access permissions as the Data Download tab. Nothing to install. Pick a lesson to get started. Take them in order — each one builds on the last.
intro.deeper: Want to learn R more deeply? See WorldFish's full course:

intro.title: Welcome — your first look at the data
intro.description: Start here. What R is, how this page works, and your first results — no experience needed.

dataset.title: Getting to know your data
dataset.description: What's inside your data — what each row is, what the columns mean, and how trips and catches fit together. Browse your own records.

find.title: Find what you need
find.description: Three simple commands to narrow your data: list the values in a column, keep only the rows you want, and keep only the columns you want.

summarise.title: Add it up
summarise.description: Total, average and count your catch by district, gear or kind of fish to answer everyday questions.

chart.title: See it as a picture
chart.description: Turn one of your own totals into a simple bar chart — the kind you can put in a report or show to a supervisor.

recipes.title: Your recipe card
recipes.description: Every command from the course on one page. Print it or photograph it, and keep it beside you.
